  |
2 | use example.com/t/q as Aa
  |                        ^
  |
help: write the canonical line (synod fmt does this)
  |
2 - use example.com/t/q as Aa
2 + use example.com/t/q as aa
  |

  |               ^
  |
help: write the canonical line (synod fmt does this)
  |
2 - define Count [N: number]
